description: rhize-devflow — lightweight SessionStart banner. Heavier guard hooks (duplicate-check, prewrite mutation check, rca-enforcer, regression-guard) ship bundled under this directory and inside each skill but are OPT-IN: wire them into your project's .claude/settings.json when you want them, so nothing untested fires automatically on every session.

hooks.command: DEV=false; { [ -f next.config.ts ] || [ -f next.config.js ] || [ -f next.config.mjs ] || [ -f sanity.config.ts ] || [ -f package.json ]; } && DEV=true; if [ "$DEV" = true ]; then echo '## rhize-devflow active — context-engineering, error-lifecycle, data-mutation, sentry, chrome-devtools, sanity. Commands: /rhize-devflow:*'; else echo ''; fi
